text: At New North Ventures, we are visionary pioneers, seasoned operators, and strategic innovators driven by a relentless pursuit to create an asymmetric advantage in defense of our country. We support founders and companies with bold ideas and democratic values who are operating at the nexus of national security and economic resilience to build a stronger tomorrow. We're former company operators and government professionals turned venture capitalists. Having worked in both worlds, we help founders navigate the complex intersection of startups and government, finding outlier companies before the market discovers them. Our experience spans national security, AI, and deep tech. As a fund of founders and operators, we bring hands-on insight across operations, marketing, fundraising, and scaling, allowing us to offer actionable guidance, anticipate challenges, and identify exceptional opportunities early. Our deep networks across defense, intelligence, and special operations communities strengthen our ability to support companies building critical solutions with both national security and commercial impact.
